what: The public data hosts an unattended agent lane may WebFetch (read-only). ONE list: desks/mt5/scripts/Run-DeskCycle.ps1 turns each entry into a WebFetch(domain:<host>) allow rule for the noon CRO lane, and libs/ops/agent_denials.py (load_webfetch_domains / webfetch_rules) serves the same list to every Python consumer. Never copy it into a second file.
rule: A host is listed only when every source it serves is `confirmed` on the alt_proxies TERMS gate (government open data under a stated licence, CC/CC0, a documented public statistics API, or a written grant of reuse) and robots.txt does not disallow the data path. `to_confirm` and `refused` sources are never listed. Removing a host is always allowed; adding one needs its terms evidence in `terms`.
evidence: desks/mt5/research/alt_proxies.py TERMS gate, lines 2315-2372 on branch claude/paid-substitutes-consumer (PR #148)

domains.terms: US Census documented public API, public domain
e-Stat documented API; free reuse incl. commercial, CC BY 4.0 compatible
Government of India press releases (PIB), public
Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use (CC BY compatible)
NBS terms of service: download and use of NBS statistics, reuse with attribution
KOBIS documented Open API (Korean Film Council)
Seoul Open Data Plaza, KOGL type 1
SingStat Table Builder API, Singapore Open Data Licence
DATA.GOV.HK terms: commercial and non-commercial reuse, free, with attribution
INEGI Terminos de Libre Uso: commercial exploitation allowed with credit
TUIK legal notice: reuse without permission, source cited
data.go.kr: unrestricted use (no restriction on permitted scope)
